description: Real-time GI update scheduler (S2-01) on its fake back end (debugFakeSolve, developer mode): the art museum's front outdoor lamp switched off and on again, 9 s apart, the game paused. The on load must log a [GiSched] line where the lot load baked and landed layers, the switches were compose-only updates and nothing else re-baked (moved, added and build 0), within the budget. Run with -AB.

fail: \[GiSched\] lot=[1-9A-F][0-9A-F]* queued=\d+ inFlight=\d+ idle=\d+ fading=\d+ issued: moved=0 added=0 build=0 load=[1-9]\d*; landed=[1-9]\d* .*composeOnly=[1-9]\d*

expect: \[GiSched\] lot=[1-9A-F][0-9A-F]* queued=\d+ inFlight=\d+ idle=\d+ fading=\d+ issued: moved=0 added=0 build=0 load=[1-9]\d*; landed=[1-9]\d* .*composeOnly=[1-9]\d*
